name: tone3000-preset-builder
title_zh: 给 TONE3000 吉他插件生成整条信号链预设
tagline_zh: 从一首歌、一段 Solo 或一句“暖厚过载”直接生成 .t3kpreset 文件。
tagline_en: Turn a song, a riff, or a plain-English tone into a load-ready .t3kpreset — pedal to amp to cab to reverb, all.
desc_en: Build complete, ready-to-load signal-chain presets (.t3kpreset files) for the free TONE3000 NAM guitar/bass plugin and standalone app — pedal → amp → cab → outboard → reverb chains, mono and stereo, or preamp-only DI chains for players reamping into real power amps and cabs — from an artist, a song, a section of a song, or a plain-English tone description, using real captures searched live on tone
why_zh: 不是给你一堆参数让你自己拧，而是用实时搜索的 NAM 真实采样，按你描述的音色自动拼出完整链。
why_en: Instead of handing you knobs, it searches live NAM captures and assembles the whole chain for you — mono, stereo, or DI for.
limit_zh: 只认 TONE3000 插件和 .t3kpreset 格式；需要联网搜索 tone.net 上的采样。
limit_en: Only for TONE3000 plugin and .t3kpreset format; requires internet to search tone.net captures, offline yields empty shells. Does not set modulation.
title_en: Full signal-chain presets for the TONE3000 guitar plugin
